name: Feral Fighter (Combat, Heritage)
body:
You were born with—or developed—claws or fangs that you can use in battle.

Prerequisite(s): Aberration, dragon, fey, magical beast, monstrous humanoid, or undead type and/or reptilian subtype.

Benefit(s): Choose bite or 2 claws. You gain the natural weapon(s) chosen, as normal for a creature of your size. You may not gain a natural weapon of a type you already possess in this fashion. Special: You may select this feat up to two times.
